title: Scylla Manager
description: Health check, repair and backup status of the clusters managed by Scylla Manager.

list.name: repair_task
list.label: Repair task
list.definition: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

query.query: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

list.name: backup_task
list.label: Backup task
list.definition: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

query.query: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"})

100 * (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"}) / clamp_min(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"}, 1)
100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|", mode="idle"}[5m])))

panels.title: Scylla Manager -> cluster nodes connectivity health check

targets.expr: count(scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) != 1) or vector(0)
count(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) != 1) or vector(0)
count(scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) != 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes not healthy for the whole range

targets.expr: label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -1 unless on(cluster, dc, rack, host) (min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -2), "protocol", "CQL", "", "") or label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -1, "protocol", "REST", "", "") or label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -1 unless on(cluster, dc, rack, host) (min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -2), "protocol", "Alternator", "", "") or label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -2, "protocol", "Agent", "", "")
scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}
scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}
scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: Repair tasks
panels.description: Name, Type and Cron are the task's current configuration. The remaining properties are the ones the most recent run started with, so they stay unchanged until the task runs again and are empty until it runs for the first time after Scylla Manager restarts.

targets.expr: max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))

(max by (task) ((time() - scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"}) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))) or (max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) * 0 + 99999999)

max by (task) ((scylla_manager_repair_task_progress{cluster="$cluster"} or avg by (cluster, task) (scylla_manager_tablet_repair_progress{cluster="$cluster"})) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))
max by (task, name, cron, type) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"})

max by (task, keyspace, dc, keyspace_replication, incremental_mode, host, fail_fast) (scylla_manager_repair_task_properties{cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))

(max by (task) ((scylla_manager_repair_task_progress{cluster="$cluster"} or avg by (cluster, task) (scylla_manager_tablet_repair_progress{cluster="$cluster"})) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} == 1)) or max by (task) ((scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} != 1) - 10)) * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) by (task))

options.content: 🔵 running · ● never executed yet · 🔴 prev execution failed · 🟡 prev execution stopped

panels.title: Time since the last successful repair
Time since the last successful repair

targets.expr: time() - max by (name) (scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{cluster="$cluster"} * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) by (task)))

panels.title: Backup tasks
panels.description: Name and Cron are the task's current configuration. The remaining properties are the ones the most recent run started with, so they stay unchanged until the task runs again and are empty until it runs for the first time after Scylla Manager restarts.

targets.expr: max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{cluster="$cluster", type="backup"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))

(max by (task) ((time() - scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{cluster="$cluster", type="backup"}) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))) or (max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}) * 0 + 99999999)
max by (task) (scylla_manager_backup_task_progress{cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))
max by (task, name, cron) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"})

max by (task, keyspace, dc, location, retention, retention_days, method, purge_only, skip_schema, retention_lock_mode) (scylla_manager_backup_task_properties{cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))

(max by (task) (scylla_manager_backup_task_progress{cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{cluster="$cluster", type="backup"} == 1)) or max by (task) ((scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{cluster="$cluster", type="backup"} != 1) - 10)) * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}) by (task))

options.content: 🔵 running · ● never executed yet · 🔴 prev execution failed · 🟡 prev execution stopped

panels.title: Time since the last successful backup
Time since the last successful backup

targets.expr: time() - max by (name) (scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{cluster="$cluster"} * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}) by (task)))
